name: review.accept
title: review.accept
summary: Legacy compatibility: agent changes are accepted immediately; accepting again is harmless.
html:
Legacy compatibility: agent changes are accepted immediately; accepting again is harmless.

  • Scope: edit:scene
  • Service: core

#Params

ParamRequiredDescription
sessionyesSession handle from session.begin.
txnTransaction (tx_...). With entity, only that entity's changes in it.
entityEntity (e_8b21, or sc_arena001/e_8b21 to name the document). Without txn: its changes in every unreviewed transaction.
allEvery unreviewed transaction.
